contexts.text: Go to Paddan Aram () = the Knowledges of such truth; (for) Aram, or Syria, = Knowledges. The reason Paddan Aram = the Knowledges of truth, is derived from the fact that it was in Syria of Rivers, where were Nahor, Bethuel, and Laban. AC 3675.

Sent him to Paddan Aram () = the beginning of the manifestation by means of the Knowledges of this good... Paddan Aram = the Knowledges of truth. It is said Knowledges of good, because all truths are Knowledges of good... but in so far as they regard doctrine, they are called Knowledges of truth.
And (Jacob) went to Paddan Aram () to imbue the Knowledges of that good and truth... which are signified by Paddan Aram.
Which he acquired in Paddan Aram () = the Knowledges of good and truth in the Natural. Paddan Aram = the Knowledges of good and truth.

In coming thither from Paddan Aram () = after the former state... Paddan Aram = the Knowledges of good and truth, but exterior Knowledges, which subserve for the introducing of genuine goods and truths; for Laban was there, by whom is represented the affection of such good.

God appeared to Jacob again in his coming from Paddan Aram, and blessed him () = interior natural perception... Again in his coming from Paddan Aram = after he had imbibed the Knowledges of good and truth.

These are the sons of Jacob which were born to him in Paddan Aram () = their origin and state at this time... Their origin is signified by their being born in Paddan Aram, or from the Knowledges of truth and good. AC 6024:3.
Their being born in Paddan Aram represented that the man of the Church must be regenerated by means of the Knowledges of good and truth.
In my coming from Paddan () = from a state of Knowledges; (for) Paddan Aram = the Knowledges of truth and good. References.
